agent_explanation: Single ball dropped from 10.3m hits floor between steps 60-61. Impact speed ~18.67 m/s downward should rebound with speed <= e*impact ~16.94 m/s (e=0.907). Instead rebound is 19.73 m/s upward, gaining kinetic energy. Total mechanical energy jumps from 3017 J to 3363 J, exceeding allowed 3324 J. Likely cause: floor collision uses positional correction to resolve penetration but does not remove the added potential energy, and/or impulse calculation overcompensates when substeps>1 (7 substeps), injecting net energy on bounce.
